notes: Added browser and game-page recovery for supported automations when the game tab crashes or becomes temporarily unavailable.
Standardized browser startup so new sessions open the main Pockie Ninja website while existing Pockie Ninja sessions keep their current server.
Improved Outfit Collection planning, pot selection, collection progress handling, and repeated scan performance.
Improved automation recovery and state handling across supported game activities.

sections.title: New Features
items: Browser / Game Page Recovery — Supported automations can detect an interrupted or crashed game page, pause safely, restore the page, and continue after the game becomes available again.
Shared Browser Session Handling — Automations now reuse an existing Pockie Ninja browser session and preserve its current server instead of forcing a specific server URL.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Standardized new browser sessions to open the main Pockie Ninja website instead of a hard-coded game server.
Improved recovery behavior for renderer and game-page interruptions while keeping existing login, disconnect, maintenance, and server-availability handling.

Improved recovery across Arena, Outfit Collection, Auto Sell, Clan Boss, Clan Garden, Konoha Boutique, Las Noches, Ninja Trial, Sichibukai, Slot Machine, Tailed Beast, Valhalla, and other supported workflows.
Improved Outfit Collection with clearer Collection Categories and pot permissions.
Improved Outfit Collection planning statuses and pot-selection usability.
Collection category and pot-selection changes can update the plan without requiring another full game-state scan.
Improved repeated Outfit Collection scans by reusing verified pot catalog data during the current session.
Improved slow-server handling across Collection navigation, Inventory transitions, pot selection, and synthesis.
Improved overall automation recovery and state handling during delayed or interrupted game interactions.

sections.title: Fixes
items: Fixed inconsistent browser startup URLs across automations when no debugging browser session is available.
Fixed supported automations unnecessarily losing their active workflow when the game page can be safely restored after a renderer or tab failure.
Fixed Outfit Collection plan counters becoming out of sync after an outfit was successfully completed and submitted.
Fixed pot-selection changes causing reviewed plans and executable actions to become inconsistent.
Fixed misleading Outfit Collection availability states when compatible pots are present but protected from automation use.
Fixed unnecessary repeated Outfit Collection scans after planning-only configuration changes.
Fixed recovery cases where automation could remain stuck or repeat interactions after delayed or interrupted game states.
